sources.air_quality: OpenAQ S3 daily archive, raw station measurements aggregated to hourly means (provider CPCB; owners MPCB/BMC/IITM)
sources.weather: Co-located OpenAQ station weather measurements where available; Open-Meteo ERA5 reanalysis fills missing hours. Per-station measured fractions are recorded in stations[].weather.

unit_conversions.co_note: CPCB CO feed is mg/m3; OpenAQ labels it ppb but values are ppm (legacy co-located sensor cross-check).

qc.coverage_gate_per_hour: archived hours need >= 2 raw readings when the sensor cadence is sub-hourly
qc.provider_filter: station owner/provider contains MPCB, BMC, IITM or CPCB; location active within 21 days

attribution: Data from OpenAQ (CPCB/MPCB/BMC/IITM) and Open-Meteo (ERA5). Check upstream licences before redistribution.
